propositions: Sixteen production call sites currently invoke emit_shadow_snapshot across _mcp_llm.py (five LLM sites), _lib_ops.py (ten sites covering three LLM workflows and seven non-LLM bridge operations), and the reconciler; all must migrate before the shadow machinery is deleted.

Four public LLM entry points (review_code, verify_completion, review_plan, scan_epics_for_spec, plus run_workflow) must compose exactly one LLMConfig snapshot at the operation boundary, with nested gate/workflow steps receiving the same context instance without re-resolving environment.

LLM config composition must fail fast on unresolvable auth/provider/credential errors before external calls (unlike the general snapshot's fail-open behavior), with no ambient fallback or cross-provider resolution.

Non-LLM bridge/reconciler sites (seven in _lib_ops.py, one in the reconciler) must migrate from emit_shadow_snapshot onto the existing general compose_and_bind_operation_snapshot binding to complete ADR 3a08's cutover.

Mutating LLM settings (model, provider, timeout, retry, cache, headers, tracing, repository) after operation composition cannot affect an in-progress multi-step run; subsequent operations observe the mutation.
LLMRuntime and ProviderSession remain authoritative for live auth and provider resources; secrets and live capabilities must not enter snapshot serialization, fingerprints, logs, or exceptions.
